description:
Qualification:  
 - 5+ years JAVA Web UI development experience in high quality interactive UI and UX using EXTJS, Angular JS, JQuery 
 - 5+ years Core JAVA Application development experience in developing distributed mission-critical Trading or Transactional Analytics system based on Core JAVA and J2EE 
 - 5+ years DB programming experience – Design and build enterprise scale high-volume Oracle and Sybase database processing using packages, procedures, Triggers, PL/SQL, JAVA stored procedures 
 - Experience in MVC design pattern and Implementation 
 - Ability to work under pressure, take ownership of issues and propose solutions 
 - Proactive and possess strong Analytical and problem solving skills and ability to multi-task 
 - Excellent communication skills 
 

 Preferred experience:  
 - Experience in developing data analysis and data mining applications using business intelligence tools such as Qlikview and SPOTFire or JAVA custom development 
 - Financial products knowledge in Future & Options, Forex, Commodities, Equities, Trade life cycle and work flows 
 

 Role Responsibilities:  
 - Design and build strategic high-volume platform that leverage EXTJS, Core JAVA online, Batch Analytics processing, Oracle data models and PL/SQL processing 
 - Design and build transactional detection patterns and analytics reports 
 - Design and Implement user interface for high-performance analytics visualization, workflow and case management platform using best-in-breed UX principles 
 - Follow SDLC best practices/process to ensure code quality, Performance, stability and scalability 
 - End-to-end Design, build and delivery 
 - Release/deployment knowledge, coordination and support 
 - Provide L3 production support
 


 EXTJS, Angular JS, JQuery, Core JAVA Application development PL/SQL 

 Multiple Openings for GC/Citizen
